national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with India's Asian Games 2026 Contingent
bullets: India finished fourth in the medal tally at the 2026 Asian Games held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, securing 85 medals including 21 gold, 27 silver, and 37 bronze.
Major achievements included double Gold victories in men's and women's hockey (ending a 44-year wait for the women's team), dual Golds in Kabaddi, and five Golds in archery.
The contingent achieved historic milestones, including a weightlifting medal after 28 years and the first marathon success since 1982.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry Hosts National Sports Federations Conclave 2026
bullets: Union Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya addressed the National Sports Federations (NSFs) Conclave 2026 in New Delhi to review India's performance at the 2026 Asian Games.
The ministry emphasized integrating sports science, sports psychology, and mental training experts into athlete preparation, aligned with the Khelo India Mission.
The conclave served as a planning platform for upcoming global events: the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, 2030 Commonwealth Games in Ahmedabad, and 2030 Asian Games in Doha.

national_news.title: India's Defence Exports Surge to Over ₹38,000 Crore
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced that India's defence exports surged from ₹686 crore in 2013-14 to more than ₹38,000 crore in 2025-26, with indigenous products now exported to nearly 100 countries.
India has achieved over 90% self-reliance in ammunition variants, with 159 out of 175 variants in the Indian Army's inventory being indigenous.
The Minister highlighted major strategic shifts through operations like the Balakot Airstrikes, Surgical Strikes, and Operation Sindoor to proactively counter cross-border terrorism.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Inaugurates Infrastructure Projects Worth ₹3,350 Crore in Ladakh
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi virtually inaugurated five major development projects worth around ₹3,350 crore in the Union Territory of Ladakh.

Key projects include the new Passenger Terminal Building at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport in Leh (equipped with India's first geothermal heating facility), the 298-km Nimmu-Padum-Darcha Road, and the 9-MW Hanu Small Hydroelectric Project.

The newly opened Nimmu-Padum-Darcha Road, constructed by the Border Roads Organisation, reduces travel time from 12 hours to 3 hours, connecting Leh in Ladakh to Darcha in Himachal Pradesh through the Zanskar Valley.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Inaugurates National SARAS Mela 2026 in Vijayawada
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the National SARAS Mela 2026 in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, emphasizing the economic empowerment of rural women for achieving Viksit Bharat by 2047.

Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced that the target of creating 3 crore Lakhpati Didis has been achieved ahead of schedule, with a new target set for 6 crore Lakhpati Didis.
The SARAS Mela, organized for the first time outside Delhi, serves as a vital platform for women self-help groups (SHGs) to showcase traditional crafts and access urban consumer markets.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet approves continuation and renaming of National Social Assistance Programme
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) for five years from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with a total outlay of Rs 53,428 crore.
The scheme has been renamed as Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana, along with the renaming of sub-schemes for old age, widows, divyangjan, and family benefit.

Assistance for the divyangjan pension has been revised, lowering the benchmark disability criteria to 40% from 80% and extending coverage to an estimated 3.20 crore beneficiaries across all 36 States and UTs.

national_news.title: India Condemns Attacks on Civil Infrastructure in Saudi Arabia and Expresses Solidarity
bullets: India formally expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia and condemned the attacks on civil infrastructure, including the recent attack on the Aramco headquarters.
The Ministry of External Affairs emphasized that attacks on civil infrastructure are unacceptable and reiterated India's support for the sovereignty and security of Saudi Arabia.
MEA also dismissed the UN Human Rights Commissioner's (OHCHR) remarks on the national capital as unwarranted and lacking universal consistency.

national_news.title: IEA Warns Global Oil Supply Recovery is Fragile Due to Gulf Attacks
bullets: The International Energy Agency (IEA) warned in its monthly Oil Market Report that renewed attacks in the Gulf make global oil supply recovery fragile.
Global oil supply is projected to decline to an average of 100.7 million barrels per day (bpd) this year before rebounding by 7.7 million bpd in 2027.
Diesel markets remain under significant strain with global demand projected to fall amid supply disruptions linked to the West Asian conflict.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Updates: Patna Zoo Toy Train Revival, JEEViKA 20 Years & Smriti Mandhana as UNICEF Advocate
bullets: The toy train at Sanjay Gandhi Biological Park (Patna Zoo) is set to resume in January 2027 with a Vande Bharat-inspired design manufactured in Samastipur.
JEEViKA (Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society) completed 20 years, linking 1.81 crore households to 13.06 lakh self-help groups (SHGs) and facilitating ₹76,549 crore in bank credit.
Indian women's cricket captain Smriti Mandhana was named UNICEF India Celebrity Advocate on the International Day of the Girl.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Inaugurates ₹140.95 Crore Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster in Muzaffarpur
bullets: The Mega Leather, Footwear and Accessories Cluster was inaugurated at BIADA Industrial Area in Mahwal, Muzaffarpur, at a cost of ₹140.95 crore.
The project features a Common Facility Centre (CFC) to boost manufacturing, attract investments, and curb out-migration by creating local employment before 2030.
The state government also reiterated its target of developing a 1,000 MW data centre capacity before 2030.
